title: Age-Triggered Tier Conversion Settings for Personal Checking
content:
Deposit Operations converts an account of a Personal Checking tier automatically at the next statement cycle close once the owner reaches the age the tier sets for that conversion, and moves it onto the tier named as the conversion target.

| Tier | Age at which the account converts automatically (whole years) | Tier the account converts into |
|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | not applicable | not applicable |
| Student Checking | 25 | Everyday Checking |
| Everyday Checking | not applicable | not applicable |
| Interest Checking | not applicable | not applicable |
| Premier Checking | not applicable | not applicable |
| Private Client Checking | not applicable | not applicable |

Where the conversion age reads as not applicable, the tier has no age-triggered conversion and the account stays where it is however old the owner becomes.

**Worked illustration (hypothetical).** An owner of a Student Checking account turns 25 in whole years during a statement cycle. Because the tier sets 25 as its conversion age and Everyday Checking as its conversion target, the account is converted at the close of that cycle onto Everyday Checking. An owner of an Access Checking account who turns 25 in the same cycle is not converted, because that tier's setting is not applicable.
